name: cruise
description: Route coding work into six exclusive evidence-backed workflows, from quick edits to durable native Goals.

interface.longDescription: Cruise preserves the raw request, probes and routes once, then applies one of six exclusive workflows: durable Build foundations and milestones, bounded Quick edits, finite Refine plans, durable native Goals, systematic Debug repair, or source-backed Research. Machine records are YAML, model choices resolve against host capabilities, and the Goal terminal client retains separate byte-locked Plan and Start approvals.
defaultPrompt: Use $cruise:build to establish this project foundation or next milestone.
Use $cruise:quick for this exact small change.
Use $cruise:refine to approve and execute this finite feature.
Use $cruise:goal to stage and durably execute this migration.
